title: Crispy Chicken Hash
description: A crispy chicken hash dish that combines chicken and potatoes for a delicious meal. This recipe is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a bowl, mix together chicken, nutmeg, and garlic salt.
In a separate pan, cook hash browns according to package instructions.
In a separate pan, heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium heat.
Add chicken to the pan and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Transfer chicken to a baking sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes.
Add cooked hash browns to the baking sheet with the chicken and toss to combine.
Top with crispy fried onions and serve hot.
